questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The possibility to go to a well-respected university with english as the language taught

Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I had some problems with the University due to courses getting cancelled. They were not very informative.

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: In London your only real possibility outside of campus is the Danish YWCA in hampstead. It is easy to book if you do it in time.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: In London it is almost impossible to find accomodation - both on and off campus. the Danish YWCA is by far the best option.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Easy and swift.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I did not need help, but it was easy to contact the administration through mail

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not very succesfull. two courses got cancelled after the semester had started

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do it as fast as possible.
